meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扫描你的代码库,按 9 个维度找技术债,每条发现都标注 file:line:col,并在仓库根目录生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,内含严重度分级、工时估算和按优先级排序的修复清单。
howto.when: 当你要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计、架构评审等,或提到「tech debt」「code health」这类关键词时触发;超大代码库会把较重的维度交给并行子代理处理。

say.text: 帮我审计这个仓库的技术债,输出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 会在仓库根目录生成报告文件

say.text: 重点深挖架构和错误处理这两个维度的债务
say.note: 只对指定维度跑深入检查

say.text: 把超过 500 行的文件和空 catch 块列出来

howto.what_en: Claude scans your repo across 9 debt dimensions using AST-grep, grep and LSP, cites every finding as file:line:col, and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md to the repo root with severity, hour estimates and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a codebase health check, tech debt audit or architecture review, or mention terms like “tech debt” or “code health”.

say_en.text: Audit this repo for tech debt and write TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Report lands in the repo root.

say_en.text: Focus on the architecture and error-handling dimensions only
say_en.note: Only those dimensions get deep passes.

say_en.text: List files over 500 lines and empty catch blocks
say_en.note: Each finding is cited as file:line:col.
